legend: You are given an array consisting of n%%ZSMJ0%% integers a1,a2,…,an%%ZSMJ1%%, and a positive integer m%%ZSMJ2%%. It is guaranteed that m%%ZSMJ3%% is a divisor of n%%ZSMJ4%%.
